title: Canon Zoom Lens FL 100-200mm f/5.6 - VTG Telephoto Zoom - Made In Japan W/ Case
descriptionText:
Priced to sell. For sale is a Canon Zoom Lens FL 100-200mm f/5.6, a classic telephoto zoom lens from Canon’s FL series. This lens is ideal for collectors, film photography enthusiasts, and those looking to experiment with vintage glass on digital cameras using an adapter.

Condition:
✔ Glass is clear with no major scratches, fungus, or haze (please inspect photos).
✔ Aperture and focus rings turn smoothly.
✔ Exterior shows normal wear for its age but is in good cosmetic condition.

Features:
✔ 100-200mm focal range – Great for portraits, sports, and wildlife photography.
✔ Manual focus & aperture control – Classic precision for creative photography.
✔ Solid metal construction – Durable, high-quality build.
✔ Canon FL mount – Can be adapted for use on modern mirrorless cameras (adapter not included).

Compatibility:
This lens was originally designed for Canon FL-mount film cameras but can be used on digital cameras with the appropriate adapter (e.g., FL to EOS R, FL to Sony E).

📦 Fast shipping and secure packaging!
